title: Documents requried for ITR Filing in Jabalpur
author: CA. Shantanu Singh Chauhan
content:
Ensure to keep these documents while approaching for filing of Income Tax Return
1. Form 16 (for salaried income).
2. Statement of Bank Accounts (Saving, Current etc.) held/operated during the year.
3. Your capital gain report from your shares/mutual funds/crypto

title: Extension of due date
author: CA. Shantanu Singh Chauhan
content: Date extended from 31st July, 2025 to 15th September, 2025. Please refer to CBDT Circular No 06/2025 dated 27th May, 2025.
